## Execution quality: daily TCA (exchange fills + OTC/broker)

**To reuse:** open *Variables* and set `day` (session to review, e.g. `'2026-11-12'`), `prev` (comparison day) and `event` (a TICK window around any market shock found in *Market context* / *Big 5-minute moves*, e.g. `'2026-11-12T14:00;30m'`). The OTC/broker counterparty cell can't take notebook variables, so edit `@otc_day` in its SQL too.

**Conventions.** Markout = signed move of the **same venue's** mid after the fill, in bps (positive = good for us). `at fill` = spread captured or paid (aggressive should be about −½ spread, passive about +½ spread). *Picked off* shows up as passive fills whose markout turns negative within seconds to minutes. USD = local P&L × `px_factor` × the day's average EURUSD/GBPUSD.

**Findings for 11 Nov 2026:** no systematic pick-off. Aggressive fills paid about ½ spread and passive fills earned about ½ spread on every venue, with no adverse drift out to 5 minutes. The big negative markouts are the **09:30–09:50 gas/power rally** (NBP, TTF, JKM, UKPWR +6–7%; oil and carbon flat), which hit whoever was short, not one counterparty. Data issues: **EEX quote-feed gap of 181 s (08:45–08:48)**; booking problems (JKM 500k→50k quantity typo, duplicate BANK_02 TTF_Q1 ticket, 34 OTC/broker trades booked the next morning).

SELECT h.offset/1000000000 AS horizon_s, concat(f.venue, CASE WHEN f.passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggressive' END) AS segment,
 avg(sign(f.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000) AS markout_bps
FROM (energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day) f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (0, 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1m, 2m, 5m) AS h
GROUP BY horizon_s, segment ORDER BY horizon_s, segment
cells.name: Markout curve by venue × liquidity (bps, + = good for us)

WITH b AS (SELECT ts, symbol, last((bid+ask)/2) AS mid FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day AND source IN ('ICE','ICE_ENDEX','CME') AND symbol IN ('NBP_Jan-27','TTF_Jan-27','UKPWR_Jan-27','JKM_Jan-27','BRENT_Jan-27','WTI_Jan-27','GASOIL_Jan-27','EUA_Dec-26','UKA_Dec-26') SAMPLE BY 5m)
SELECT ts, symbol, round(100 * mid / first_value(mid) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ts), 3) AS idx FROM b ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Market context: front months indexed to 100 (5m)

WITH m AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.ts IN @day THEN 'day' ELSE 'prev' END AS d, f.curve, f.passive, h.offset/1000000000 AS s,
   sign(f.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000 AS bps, (q.ask-q.bid)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000 AS spr
 FROM (energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day OR ts IN @prev) f
 HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
 LIST (0, 10s, 1m, 5m) AS h)
SELECT curve, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
 sum(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fills,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=0 THEN spr END), 2) AS spread_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=0 THEN bps END), 2) AS at_fill_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=10 THEN bps END), 2) AS m10s_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=60 THEN bps END), 2) AS m1m_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='day' AND s=300 THEN bps END), 2) AS m5m_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='prev' AND s=0 THEN bps END), 2) AS prev_at_fill_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN d='prev' AND s=300 THEN bps END), 2) AS prev_m5m_bps
FROM m GROUP BY curve, liquidity ORDER BY curve, liquidity
cells.name: Curve × liquidity scorecard (bps) vs previous day

cells.value:
WITH m AS (
 SELECT f.trader, f.book, f.curve, CASE WHEN f.ts IN @event THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_event, h.offset/1000000000 AS s,
   f.qty*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px) AS pnl_local
 FROM (energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day) f
 HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
 LIST (0, 1m, 5m, 30m) AS h),
agg AS (SELECT trader, book, curve, count()/4 AS fills,
   sum(CASE WHEN s=0 THEN pnl_local END) AS l0, sum(CASE WHEN s=60 THEN pnl_local END) AS l1m,
   sum(CASE WHEN s=300 THEN pnl_local END) AS l5m, sum(CASE WHEN s=300 AND in_event=0 THEN pnl_local END) AS l5m_ex,
   sum(CASE WHEN s=1800 THEN pnl_local END) AS l30m
 FROM m GROUP BY trader, book, curve),
inst AS (SELECT DISTINCT curve, px_factor, fx_symbol FROM energy_instruments),
fx AS (SELECT symbol, avg((bid+ask)/2) AS usd FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('EURUSD','GBPUSD') GROUP BY symbol),
u AS (SELECT a.*, i.px_factor * coalesce(x.usd, 1.0) AS k FROM agg a JOIN inst i ON a.curve = i.curve LEFT JOIN fx x ON i.fx_symbol = x.symbol)
SELECT trader, book, sum(fills) AS fills, round(sum(l0*k)) AS usd_at_fill, round(sum(l1m*k)) AS usd_1m, round(sum(l5m*k)) AS usd_5m, round(sum(l5m_ex*k)) AS usd_5m_ex_event, round(sum(l30m*k)) AS usd_30m
FROM u GROUP BY trader, book ORDER BY usd_5m
cells.name: Trader scorecard: markout P&L in USD (ex-event = excluding @event window)

WITH b AS (SELECT ts, symbol, last((bid+ask)/2) AS c FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day AND source IN ('ICE','ICE_ENDEX','CME') AND symbol IN ('NBP_Jan-27','TTF_Jan-27','BRENT_Jan-27','WTI_Jan-27','UKPWR_Jan-27','EUA_Dec-26','UKA_Dec-26','JKM_Jan-27','GASOIL_Jan-27') SAMPLE BY 5m),
r AS (SELECT ts, symbol, c, (c / lag(c) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ts) - 1)*100 AS pct FROM b)
SELECT ts, symbol, c AS mid, round(pct, 2) AS ret_pct FROM r WHERE abs(pct) > 0.6 ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Big 5-minute moves (front months, |ret| > 0.6%)

WITH m AS (
 SELECT f.ts, f.trader, f.symbol, f.venue, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, h.offset/1000000000 AS s,
   sign(f.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000 AS bps
 FROM (energy_fills WHERE ts IN @event) f
 HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
 LIST (0, 1m, 5m, 30m) AS h)
SELECT ts, trader, symbol, venue, passive, qty, px,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN s=0 THEN bps END), 1) AS at_fill, round(avg(CASE WHEN s=60 THEN bps END), 1) AS m1m,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN s=300 THEN bps END), 1) AS m5m, round(avg(CASE WHEN s=1800 THEN bps END), 1) AS m30m
FROM m GROUP BY ts, trader, symbol, venue, passive, qty, px ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Fills inside @event window (bps markouts, + = good)

WITH s AS (SELECT ts, source, count() AS n FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day AND source != 'FX_FEED' SAMPLE BY 1s),
g AS (SELECT source, ts, ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY source ORDER BY ts) AS gap FROM s)
SELECT source, ts AS resumed_at, gap / 1000000000.0 AS gap_s FROM g WHERE gap > 5000000000 ORDER BY gap_s DESC
cells.name: Quote-feed gaps > 5 s (data issue, not execution)

SELECT channel, count() AS trades,
 sum(CASE WHEN booked_ts >= dateadd('d', 1, timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_next_day,
 round(avg(datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts))) AS avg_delay_min, max(datediff('m', trade_ts, booked_ts)) AS max_delay_min
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1 GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
cells.name: Booking timeliness by channel

-- NOTE: the console cannot inject notebook variables into this cell (re-timestamped subquery), so edit the date here too.
DECLARE @otc_day := '2026-11-11'
WITH otc_trades AS (
  SELECT * FROM (SELECT trade_ts, symbol, qty, px, channel, counterparty FROM energy_trade_events
  WHERE trade_ts IN @otc_day AND channel != 'EXCH' AND version = 1 AND status = 'NEW' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)
),
mk AS (SELECT split_part(o.counterparty, '_', 1) AS cpty_type, o.channel, hz.offset/1000000 AS s,
   sign(o.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - o.px)/((q.bid+q.ask)/2)*10000 AS bps
 FROM otc_trades o HORIZON JOIN (energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('ICE','ICE_ENDEX','CME')) q ON (o.symbol = q.symbol)
 LIST (0, 1m, 5m, 30m) AS hz)
SELECT cpty_type, channel, count()/4 AS trades, round(avg(CASE WHEN s=0 THEN bps END), 2) AS at_trade_bps, round(avg(CASE WHEN s=60 THEN bps END), 2) AS m1m_bps,
 round(avg(CASE WHEN s=300 THEN bps END), 2) AS m5m_bps, round(avg(CASE WHEN s=1800 THEN bps END), 2) AS m30m_bps
FROM mk GROUP BY cpty_type, channel ORDER BY m5m_bps
cells.name: OTC/broker by counterparty type, bps vs primary mid (date set in SQL: @otc_day)

SELECT e.trade_ts, e.booked_ts, e.version, e.status, e.reason, e.channel, e.counterparty, e.trader, e.book, e.symbol, e.qty, e.px, e.trade_id
FROM energy_trade_events e
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT trade_id FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version > 1) x ON e.trade_id = x.trade_id
ORDER BY e.trade_id, e.version, e.booked_ts
